about: Christopher Nolland is an attorney who represents clients in the Dallas, Texas area. Christopher Nolland is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Nolland chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Albany Law School and graduated in 1977. Christopher Nolland passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1978.
He represents clients with Alternative Dispute Resolution issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Business Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Nolland has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
